Give your old jeans a second life! ♻️👖 In this quick video, I’ll show you how to sew this trendy Korean-style mini crossbody bag.
It’s the perfect one-evening project for beginners. It features a secure inside zipper pocket 🤐 and that high-end "denim aesthetic" look for zero cost! 💎💸
Ready to sew? 🧵Watch the FULL step-by-step tutorial on my channel! ✨https://youtu.be/AouQ2b9UOYs

#upcycling #denimbag #sewingtutorial #diycrafts #koreanstyle

❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Old denim jeans 👖 (or denim fabric remnants)
🔹 Thick fusible interfacing (stiff stabilizer) 
🔹 Thin fusible interfacing (approx. 60 gsm) 
🔹 D-rings (2 pieces) — 0.8" or 1" wide (20-25 mm)
🔹 #3 Nylon coil zipper by the yard (two pieces: 7" and 10") — (18 cm and 25 cm)
🔹Lining cotton fabric 🧵
